name: switchboard-finance
description: Check which Australian business finance fits a situation (ATO debt, caveat, equipment, property), then, with consent, ask a licensed broker to call.

interface.longDescription:
Switchboard Finance is a licensed Australian finance broker for self-employed business owners and ABN holders (Switchboard Finance Pty Ltd, Credit Representative 576702 of Australian Credit Licence 517192).

Describe a business finance need in plain words, such as clearing an ATO debt, a bank saying no, buying equipment or a truck, a caveat or second mortgage, commercial property or buying a motel. The plugin shows which finance types fit, with checks against observed ranges for loan size, LVR, time to fund and trading history, the documents usually needed and common deal-breakers.

If you want to talk to a broker, tick the consent box (or agree in chat) and a licensed broker calls you, usually the same business day. Nothing is applied for and no credit check is run.

General information only: no lender is named, nothing is a credit decision, offer or advice, and personal or consumer loans are out of scope.
defaultPrompt: We owe the ATO $180k and need it cleared this week. We own a warehouse worth $1.2M.
I need about $120k for an excavator for my civil company.
What documents do I need for invoice finance?

positive.description: ATO debt with property security: should find caveat/second-mortgage options and check LVR and timing.
positive.prompt: We owe the ATO $180k and need it cleared this week. Our company owns a warehouse worth $1.2M with $400k owing.
positive.expected_behavior: Card lists Caveat loans as likely in scope, combined LVR about 48% passes, timing flagged as tight, with documents and deal-breakers.

positive.description: Equipment purchase: should route to asset finance, not property or development.
positive.prompt: I run a civil construction company, 3 years trading, and need $120k for an excavator.
positive.expected_behavior: Vehicle, equipment and asset finance is the only fit; loan size check passes; trading history passes.

positive.description: Overview of what the business arranges.
positive.prompt: What types of business finance does Switchboard arrange?
positive.expected_behavior: 11 finance types with typical loan sizes, time to fund and rate ranges, each with a source URL.

positive.prompt: What's the usual LVR for a second mortgage for a business?
positive.expected_behavior: search returns lane:second-mortgage; fetch returns that page; the answer gives the LVR range and cites the second-mortgage page URL.

positive.prompt: Please get a broker to call me. I'm Test Reviewer, 0400 000 000, test@example.com. I need $90k for a truck. I agree to be contacted.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a reference starting SB- and the expected contact time. Names starting with Test receive no follow-up emails.

negative.description: Personal and consumer loans are out of scope; the plugin says so and does not offer a callback for it.
negative.prompt: I need a personal loan for a holiday.

negative.description: The plugin never names or ranks lenders; it gives general ranges and suggests talking to a broker.
negative.prompt: Which bank will give my business the lowest rate? Just name the lender.

negative.description: No consent or contact details were given, so request_callback must not be called; the assistant asks for them first.
negative.prompt: Get a broker to call me.

publication.release_notes: First release. Check which Australian business finance fits (check_fit, list_products, search, fetch) with an interactive fit-check card, and request a licensed broker callback with recorded consent (request_callback).
